title: Spreadsheet work
idea: Spreadsheet work: Cell grid and formula context keep active selection explicit
audience: People who need to calculate within a desktop surface.
avoidWhen: The product cannot expose calculation provenance
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic ledger layout through its calculate priority and explicit commitment contract: Recalculation and persisted changes must be distinguishable
navigation: Spreadsheet work keeps the current calculate context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: Cell grid and formula context keep active selection explicit
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to calculate; users compare structured values
composition.priority: Recalculation and persisted changes must be distinguishable

imagery.role: Support the actual calculate context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Preserve row and column headers while scrolling
Respect window resizing, keyboard navigation and persistent document/workspace context.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the spreadsheet work structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no calculate content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Recalculation and persisted changes must be distinguishable
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized calculate content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Recalculation and persisted changes must be distinguishable
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active calculate context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure representative large documents/collections and resize interaction on target OS.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
